routes: Fall back floor by floor, up to the roof.

hint.charge: A sword kill charges the gun. Hold {RMB} and shoot
hint.strike: {Q} circular strike - clear the crowd around you
card.aim.title: Aim the gun
card.aim.1: Hold {RMB} to aim: the gun comes up and you walk slowly.
card.aim.2: {LMB} shoots while you aim; without {RMB} it swings the sword.
card.aim.3: Only sword kills charge the gun. {R} reloads.
story.ending.1: *From the helicopter the whole mansion glows in every window.*
story.ending.2: *The monsters are partying in your house. Now the uninvited one is you.*
card.strike.title: The circular strike
card.strike.1: {Q} sweeps the sword all around you and throws the crowd back.
card.strike.2: It needs a long time to recharge. There is no dodge - this is the way out of a crowd.
card.crank.title: The crank
card.crank.1: Hold {E} at the crank to raise the portcullis.
card.crank.2: You cannot fight while you turn it. Let go if they reach you - the progress stays.
card.letter.title: The letter
card.letter.1: {E} reads what was slipped under the door.
